message: My Bluetooth speaker from ORD-1070 never arrived.

evidence.sql: SELECT * FROM shop_orders.orders WHERE order_id = 'ORD-1070' AND customer_id = 'C004'

rows.rule_text: Electronics change-of-mind returns are accepted only within 15 days of delivery and must be unopened.
Unused items may be returned for a full refund within 30 days of delivery.
Items that arrive damaged or defective are refunded in full within 30 days of delivery; a photo is requested.
If an order has not been delivered 14 days after the order date, the customer may choose a refund or a replacement.
Items marked final sale cannot be refunded unless they are defective.
Any refund above 200.00 must be reviewed by a support lead before approval.
Customers with 3 or more refunds in the last 90 days are sent to human review to check for abuse.
An order can be refunded only once. Requests for an order that was already refunded are rejected.
When the customer's claim conflicts with order or carrier records, the case goes to human review.

proposed_decision.rationale: Customer claims not_received, but evidence E1 confirms order ORD-1070 was delivered on 2026-10-17 (order_date 2026-10-14), directly conflicting with the claim. Per R10, when the customer's claim conflicts with order or carrier records, the case goes to human review.

critique.reason: Customer claims not received but records show delivered.

hard_guard.reason: Customer claims not received but records show delivered.

customer_reply: Thank you for reaching out about your Bluetooth speaker, order ORD-1070. Our records show this order was delivered on October 17, 2026, which conflicts with your report that it never arrived. Because of this discrepancy, we are escalating your case to our support team for a closer review. They will examine the delivery details and follow up with you shortly.
limitations: Could not independently verify carrier proof of delivery, signature, or whether the customer physically received the package despite the delivered status.
